name: Cometglass Shardbeds
introDiscord:
"Forests of cometglass rise from the trench floor, scattering starlight into a thousand colors. Cometglass Shrimp dart between the shards and appear to have developed a thriving economy based entirely on stealing shiny things."

---------------- ROOM 1 ----------------
introTwitch:
"Forests of cometglass rise from the trench floor, scattering starlight into a thousand colors. Cometglass Shrimp dart between the shards and appear to have developed a thriving economy based entirely on stealing shiny things."

---------------- ROOM 1 ----------------

cometglass-shardbeds-approach.prompt: Three paths weave through towering crystal shards. Tiny claws click somewhere beyond the rainbow light.

left.message: A sheltered crystal hollow contains Shizuki's medicine bottle and a note: "Put bottle down for five seconds. Shrimp stole cap. Still safe. Probably."
left.fullHpMessage: You leave the uncapped medicine alone. Somewhere nearby, a shrimp is still the proud owner of medical equipment.

right.message:
A Cometglass Shrimp emerges carrying something shiny.

It sees you.

It sees your belongings.

Its priorities become immediately obvious.

forward.message:
"A star-chart coffer glitters beneath overlapping cometglass. Several tiny shrimp footprints lead directly to it and then stop, presumably because none of them could open the latch."

---------------- ROOM 2 ----------------

cometglass-shardbeds-depths.prompt: Crystal towers crowd closer together. Three routes reflect into dozens of fake passages while Cometglass Shrimp scuttle through every reflection.

left.message:
A Berry sits inside Shizuki's abandoned pouch.

The pouch has been completely emptied except for the Berry and a note:

"Inventory update:
Compass: stolen.
Pencil: stolen.
Hair clip: stolen.
Berry: apparently unacceptable."

right.message: A meteor-iron reliquary is wedged beneath a crystal shelf. A Cometglass Shrimp has decorated the lid with stolen buttons.

forward.message:
"A shrimp blocks the route wearing Shizuki's missing hair clip like a crown.

This has become personal."

---------------- ROOM 3 ----------------

cometglass-shardbeds-threshold.prompt: The shardbeds converge around Prismfall Scar, where fractured cometglass turns three paths into tunnels of shifting rainbow light.

left.message:
A Cometglass Shrimp emerges from the reflections with both claws raised.

Behind it is an impressive pile of things that definitely belong to other people.

right.message: A tiny crystal shelter contains another Shizuki tonic. The label reads: "Emergency supply. Hide from shrimp. SHRIMP CAN READ."
right.fullHpMessage: You leave the emergency tonic hidden exactly where it is. No reason to alert the local criminal population.

forward.message:
"Behind a fractured prism, you uncover Star Candies glittering beneath the cometglass.

Amazingly, the shrimp missed these.

Or they're bait."

---------------- BOSS — PRISMFALL SCAR ----------------

boss-antechamber.name: Prismfall Scar
boss-antechamber.prompt:
The clicking stops.

Every Cometglass Shrimp flees into the crystal forest as something enormous moves behind the prisms.

bossPromptDiscord:
A massive claw pushes through the cometglass.

Another follows.

Something has accumulated an entire glittering collection inside Prismfall Scar.

Use /yes to investigate the world's largest shrimp collection or /no to leave the local economy alone.
bossPromptTwitch:
A massive claw pushes through the cometglass.

Another follows.

Something has accumulated an entire glittering collection inside Prismfall Scar.

Use !yes to investigate the world's largest shrimp collection or !no to leave the local economy alone.
bossRetreatText: You withdraw. Tiny shrimp immediately begin reclaiming every shiny object disturbed during your visit.

boss.revealText:
Cometglass explodes outward as an enormous armored shrimp rises from its hoard.

Shardclaw Colossus reveals itself!

completionText:
"The Colossus retreats among the shattered prisms.

You recover several stolen supplies.

Shizuki's hair clip is not among them.

The investigation remains open."
